release_notes:
Major internal milestone release.

- Fully integrated automatic updater with package verification and safe apply flow.
- Backend service stabilization and improved startup reliability.
- Playnite extension integration completed (catalog, install, update, uninstall, launch pipeline).
- Improved service lifecycle management and recovery behavior.
- Installer enhancements with selectable game download region (Europe, Russia, South America, China).

Next:
- Dynamic region switching inside Playnite UI.
- Automatic region detection and fallback logic in backend.
- Improved download resiliency and region failover.
